captureMethod: Browser fetch against the live API, reduced in the page before transfer.
warning: Gross and net are separate series and are never mixed. The earnings series is one household case only, a single person with no children on the national average wage, and comparing it to any other case would be comparing different things.

grossAnnual.caseLabel: Single person without children earning 100 percent of the average wage

netAnnual.caseLabel: Single person without children earning 100 percent of the average wage
netAnnual.unitMeaning: Annual net earnings after income tax and social contributions, euro

minimumWageMonthly.methodology: Statutory national minimum wage where one exists. Countries with collectively bargained minima rather than a statutory one are absent rather than zero.

notCovered.byOccupation: earn_ses runs every four years and uses ISCO groups that do not map cleanly onto the job titles people search for. It is a separate ingest and a separate decision.
notCovered.byCity: Not published below the country anywhere in this series.
notCovered.outsideEurope: Japan, Canada, New Zealand, the UAE, Thailand and Costa Rica are not in these series. Their national offices publish equivalents and each needs its own adapter.
